utility_environmental_service.label: Utility / environmental service
utility_environmental_service.value: Natural gas gathering, compression, processing and transmission, plus natural gas liquids and crude oil transportation and produced-water management.

regulated_competitive_operating_model.label: Regulated / competitive operating model
regulated_competitive_operating_model.value: Independent midstream operator competing to provide gathering, processing and other services tailored to Permian producers.

connections_service_accounts.label: Connections / service accounts
connections_service_accounts.value: Broad base of Permian producer customers for midstream services.

service_specific_rated_capacity.value: Gas processing capacity, large-scale field compression capacity and firm takeaway capacity on the Permian Highway Pipeline.

gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.value: Permian gas gathering and transmission network with third-party residue gas outlets and firm pipeline takeaway to Texas Gulf Coast markets.

water_wastewater_operations.value: Produced-water management for Permian oil and gas producers.
